source_snapshot.procedure: Snapshot CPER, inspect XGMI link status/speed, run `NUM_ITERATIONS=1000 ./TransferBench p2p 1024M`, then compare CPER after stress.
source_snapshot.criteria: TransferBench completes and no new CPER appears; any new CPER is FAIL evidence.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL marker-read only; omits AMDXIO, exact workload and actual CPER collection/comparison.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; restores signed tools/parameters, complete CPER snapshots, live link map, dedicated stress and recovery.

old_problem: Source CPER logic uses unauthenticated HTTP and only the largest numeric ID, which can miss pagination, nonnumeric IDs, wrap/retention and concurrent events. AMDXIO/TransferBench versions, live link-speed map and recovery are missing. DeepSeek performs none of the required workload or evidence steps.
disposition_reason: The exact TransferBench stimulus and no-new-CPER criterion are clear. Tools, link map and CPER schema are runtime Project inputs. Full paginated pre/post identity/timestamp sets replace maximum-ID inference, while AMDXIO verifies every expected link before/after. Any new in-window CPER stops the run and is preserved without retry.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2060, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2061 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00015-V002 / dd98dd76f572d5bf was directly read from XLSX.
The source workload is exactly 1000 iterations of 1024M p2p TransferBench; marker files or other sizes/counts do not preserve coverage.
A highest numeric CPER ID cannot prove absence of new entries; complete paginated immutable entry sets with IDs, timestamps and retention boundary are compared.
AMDXIO pre/post status/speed on the signed live GPU/XGMI graph is independent evidence that stress did not degrade links.
Protected Redfish and preserved RAS/APEI/kernel/thermal/power evidence replace HTTP and log clearing; no new CPER is filtered or acknowledged.
No AMDXIO/TransferBench run, XGMI stress, Redfish/CPER read, login, monitoring, recovery or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Exact XGMI p2p stress with complete CPER set-difference and link integrity
test_case.purpose: Exercise the complete mapped XGMI fabric with exactly 1000 TransferBench p2p iterations at 1024M and prove completion, unchanged approved link speed/status, and zero new in-window CPER records.
required_package: Exact row-2060 variant plus SUT/GPU/XGMI topology and expected link speed/status
Approved AMDXIO binary/version/checksum and link output semantics
Approved TransferBench binary/checksum and exact p2p 1024M/1000-iteration semantics
Protected Redfish Dump/CPER schema, full pagination/attachment, retention and test-window identity policy
Dedicated no-load authorization, RAS/APEI/kernel/thermal/power aborts, evidence storage and console recovery
test_case.test_command: STRESS-GATED; preserve logs and securely collect the complete paginated CPER/Dump pre-set with IDs/timestamps/hashes and boundary. Capture signed-map AMDXIO link status/speed, GPU/RAS/APEI/kernel/thermal/power baseline, prove no competing load and obtain one-run authorization. Execute exactly `NUM_ITERATIONS=1000 ./TransferBench p2p 1024M` once while monitoring. Retain full output/exit/timestamps. Recollect complete CPER set and AMDXIO status/speed, then compute an identity/time-bound set difference including attachments. Stop on any new CPER or link/health fault; no clear or rerun.
test_case.expected_result: TransferBench completes all 1000 1024M p2p iterations without error; every expected XGMI link remains present at approved speed/status; complete pre/post CPER comparison shows no new in-window record, and no new RAS/APEI/kernel, GPU, thermal or power fault occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved tools/map, exact workload completion, complete CPER set comparison, unchanged link integrity and clean health. FAIL on incomplete/error workload, any new in-window CPER, missing/downtrained link, GPU loss or health/thermal/power error. Missing tool/map/schema/authorization is NOT READY; maximum-ID or marker evidence cannot PASS.
safety_gate: High-load XGMI stress requires dedicated authorized SUT and no competing GPU traffic.
Use protected TLS/host access; preserve complete CPER/log evidence and never clear/acknowledge it.
Monitor links, GPU, RAS/APEI/kernel, thermal and power; stop on first fault or new CPER.
One exact run only; no automatic retry or fabric reset/reconfiguration.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash, signed live graph and tool checksums
Complete pre CPER pages/boundary plus pre AMDXIO/link/GPU/error/thermal/power state
Complete post CPER pages and set-difference with any attachment hashes
No-clear/no-rerun audit, recovery state and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On new CPER, workload error, link degradation, GPU loss or thermal/power fault, stop and preserve all raw first-failure evidence. Quiesce TransferBench and isolate the SUT; do not rerun or reset fabric automatically. Use only the approved console/fabric recovery under human control.
